subject: What is Scales y* in blavaan summary output?

messages.author: 9403604069d4685f
messages.subject: What is Scales y* in blavaan summary output?
parts:
Hi, I was running some models in blavaan and I got the following part in the output of the summary of the fit object:

Scales y*:
                   Estimate   Std.lv  Std.all
    A1                0.729    0.729    1.000
    A2                0.526    0.526    1.000
    A3                0.550    0.550    1.000
    C1                0.701    0.701    1.000
    C2                0.637    0.637    1.000
    C3                0.505    0.505    1.000

I was wondering what exactly does this refer to? I can recognize from the output that this only seems to concern the categorical variables, but I am still unsure what exactly was this about. I would appreciate any more information, thanks.

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: What is Scales y* in blavaan summary output?
parts:
The scales are related to the total variability in the continuous variables that are assumed to underlie the ordinal/categorical variables. See this discussion on the lavaan group:

https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/_RP2uOYC_eo/m/Xi-9lgwdAAAJ

Ed
